lines.zh: 我没有腿能迈，只能被搬动
lines.en: I have no legs; I can only be carried.
Someone carries me down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的底座在石地上蹭出声
lines.en: My base scrapes across the stone.

lines.zh: 我歪了一点，又被人扶正
lines.en: I tilt and someone sets me straight.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟着墙走，比我快
lines.en: My shadow outruns me along the wall.

lines.zh: 我经过一排监控摄像头
lines.en: I pass a row of security cameras.
The one carrying me breathes hard.
My ear knocks the door frame.

lines.zh: 我身上落下的灰跟着走
lines.en: Dust falls off me as we go.
I have been in three rooms.

lines.zh: 我被放在地上，轻轻一响
lines.en: I am set down with a soft knock.
I end up at the corridor's end.
I stand in the corner, my face all cracks.
One corner of my ear is missing.
The purple cloth has faded to grey.
I do not breathe, nor need to.
Dust fills my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两颗没光的球
lines.en: My eyes are two lightless balls.

lines.zh: 夜里我的影子比白天长
lines.en: At night my shadow runs longer.

lines.zh: 这间屋子很少有人进来
lines.en: Few people come into this room.
One of my straps has snapped.
There is a hollow ring in my wood.

lines.zh: 我一直保持着同一个姿势
lines.en: I hold one posture, always.
Someone painted my mouth crooked.

lines.zh: 我立在墙角，耳朵少了一角
lines.en: Standing in the corner, one ear missing
The ceiling light keeps flickering.
A line of light comes under the door.

lines.zh: 我的底座和地面粘在一起
lines.en: My base has stuck to the floor.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，看了很久
lines.en: You stand before me a long while.
I do not move, and cannot.
You wonder whether I am alive.

lines.zh: 这个角度能看清我的裂
lines.en: This angle shows my cracks clearly.
Do not touch my face.
You walk one circle around me.
My wood sounds hollow inside.
Ten health — don't knock me over.
You are counting the cracks on me.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吹起我肩上的灰
lines.en: Your breath lifts dust from my shoulder.
My face has frightened you.
You step back because I am smiling.
You have brought me a shadow.
You are waiting for me to move.

lines.zh: 我很想动，可我没有关节
lines.en: I want to move, but have no joints.

lines.zh: 你的灯照得我睁不开眼
lines.en: Your light is too bright for my eyes.
My face looks worse under light.

lines.zh: 我们就这样对着，谁也不动
lines.en: We face each other, neither moving.
My cracks have grown a little.

lines.zh: 一块木头从我肩上掉下来
lines.en: A chip of wood falls from my shoulder.
I lean on the wall to keep from falling.
A layer of dust shakes loose beneath me.
My arm has come loose.
The sound of my cracking is very soft.

lines.zh: 脖子上的漆，又剥落一块。
lines.en: Another flake of paint falls from my neck.
A tear has opened in my cloth.
The split in my wood reaches my neck.

lines.zh: 画上的裂口，又长了一寸。
lines.en: The crack in my paint grows an inch.
I eat nothing at all.

lines.zh: 摆在桌上的东西与我无关
lines.en: What sits on the table is not mine.

lines.zh: 你的手举着，我没有嘴去接
lines.en: You hold it out; I have no mouth for it.
I cannot even turn my head.

lines.zh: 那味道飘过来，我闻不见
lines.en: The smell drifts past; I cannot smell it.
Set it at my feet.
If you want it, eat it yourself.
My belly is hollow wood.
Hold it long enough and your arm will ache.
This mouth of mine is only painted on.
The statue swayed, but did not fall.

lines.zh: 我的底座磨着地，滑了半寸
lines.en: My base grinds and slides half an inch.
You catch me before I fall.
Wood meets wood with a dry sound.
My arm is knocked askew.
Do not push; I will shatter.
You step on my base.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，我的灰落了一地
lines.en: We collide and my dust falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我的耳朵上
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my ear.

lines.zh: 我的木头在你身上蹭了一道
lines.en: My wood leaves a mark on you.
Other ornaments stand beside me.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，也说不了
lines.en: Neither of us speaks, nor can.
Two figures stand in a row.
Her face bears cracks too.

lines.zh: 我们被摆在一起，就这样
lines.en: We are placed together, that is all.
Her ear has a missing corner too.
Ornaments do not court each other.
We stand back to back, facing apart.
One of her eyes has fallen out.

lines.zh: 我们被放在同一个柜子里
lines.en: We are put in the same cabinet.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我一个也捡不了
lines.en: I cannot pick up a single thing here.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到我脚边，我动不了
lines.en: Something rolls to my feet; I cannot move.
I can only watch it gather dust.
If only someone would pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 我的手上什么也握不住
lines.en: My hands can hold nothing.
Dust covers the thing.

lines.zh: 我只能用眼睛把它记住
lines.en: I can only remember it with my eyes.
Someone will pick it up; I am patient.
My fingers are nailed shut.

lines.zh: 我连抬手的力气也没有
lines.en: I have not the strength to lift a hand.

lines.zh: 我没有可以锁定的目标
lines.en: I have no target to lock onto.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着前面，不是盯你
lines.en: My eyes face forward, not at you.

lines.zh: 你觉得我在看，其实我在裂
lines.en: You think I watch; I am only cracking.
I am decoration; I will not chase you.

lines.zh: 我的姿势是被人摆好的
lines.en: My pose was set by someone else.
I intend to kill no one.

lines.zh: 我的脸朝前，谁走过来都一样
lines.en: My face points forward; anyone may walk in.
I never choose my opponents.
There is no hatred in my wood.
Three seconds of looking is enough.
I cannot take even one step.
If I could move, I would have.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我也不会动
lines.en: Stand still; I will not move either.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经压在你脚上
lines.en: My shadow already lies on your feet.
I have no teeth to bite with.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门在你身后
lines.en: The door of this room is behind you.
I have never chased anyone.
I stand here from morning to night.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我身上移动
lines.en: Your shadow moves across me.
I cannot even blink.

lines.zh: 我只有一双画上去的眼
lines.en: I have only painted eyes.
You leave; I stay put.

lines.zh: 我唯一会做的就是等待
lines.en: The only thing I can do is wait.
I have stood here many years.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯照着我半边脸
lines.en: The corridor light lights half my face.
Walk away and I grow small.
My shadow turns after you.

lines.zh: 我听见你在数我的裂缝
lines.en: I hear you counting my cracks.

lines.zh: 我等着，等得木头都干了
lines.en: I wait until my wood dries out.
Look back and I am still here.

lines.zh: 我从不眨眼，你也不该怕
lines.en: I never blink; you need not fear.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有我一个摆件
lines.en: I am the only ornament in this room.

lines.zh: 你走到门口，我就不见了
lines.en: Reach the door and I disappear.
I have never changed position.
I cannot throw even one punch.

lines.zh: 我只有一身裂开的木头
lines.en: I have only cracked wood.

lines.zh: 要是有人撞上来，疼的是他
lines.en: If someone runs into me, they feel the pain.

lines.zh: 我的手臂僵着，抬不起来
lines.en: My arm is stiff; it will not rise.
My claws are wooden.

lines.zh: 我只有这一下，撞在我身上
lines.en: I have only this: running into me.
My claws are frozen in the air.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，木头硌得你疼
lines.en: You hit me, and the wood hurts you.
I can only be used to smash with.
My fingers stay open and will not close.
The tip of my ear points at you.

lines.zh: 我这一下是别人替我挥的
lines.en: Someone else swings me.
My weight presses on your hand.
My arm breaks off on your shoulder.
I cannot even dodge.
I have only this shell.
I am placed in the corner.

lines.zh: 有人把我从箱子里拿出来
lines.en: Someone takes me out of a crate.

lines.zh: 我落地时底座响了一声
lines.en: My base knocks once as I land.
I face the door of this room.
My shadow falls on the wall.
I am here, motionless.
I emerge from the packing.

lines.zh: 有人把我摆正，屋里就黑了。
lines.en: Someone sets me straight, and the room goes dark.

lines.zh: 我被搬进来的时候天还亮
lines.en: It was still light when I was carried in.

lines.zh: 包装的纸还挂在我脚上
lines.en: Wrapping paper still clings to my foot.
I am set up facing the corridor.

lines.zh: 有人在门口站了一会儿
lines.en: Someone stood at the door a while.

lines.zh: 我的底座压住了一块地毯
lines.en: My base pins down a rug.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，我的眼睛还亮着漆
lines.en: The lamp dies; my painted eyes still shine.
My shadow is darker than the wall.

lines.zh: 我被摆在这一排的最后
lines.en: I am placed last in the row.

lines.zh: 我把墙角的蜘蛛网顶开了
lines.en: I push apart the cobweb in the corner.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像本来就在
lines.en: I stay still, as if I had always been.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的布，布先烧起来
lines.en: Flames reach my cloth, and the cloth catches first.
I am pushed over and break into pieces.

lines.zh: 水浸进木头里，我变重了
lines.en: Water soaks into the wood and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从底座上掀下来
lines.en: The blast throws me off my base.

lines.zh: 一颗石子打在我的脸上
lines.en: A pebble strikes my face.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的木头发出声响
lines.en: That force makes my wood creak.

lines.zh: 雕像不吃不喝，也不会烂。
lines.en: A statue neither eats nor rots.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我的每一条裂
lines.en: Lightning lights every crack I own.

lines.zh: 底座下面空了，我落下去
lines.en: My base loses its floor and I drop.
